interface.request: opcode 4, input/gamma/output bank IDs, rows in payload bits [5:0], remaining payload zero
interface.response: held done_valid/done_ready, input-bank tag, bank_count=3, all accepted bank IDs and error
interface.layout: input/output [rows,576] and gamma [576], all BF16 row-major with eight values per word
interface.completion_order: after final output word write handshake

architecture.passes: first pass computes per-row mean square; second pass reads input and gamma and writes normalized BF16 values
architecture.reduction: one BF16 element per two cycles, signed Q16.16 square and Q32.32 sum
architecture.sqrt_and_reciprocal: restoring integer algorithms, one bit per cycle; reciprocal is Q32 with 48-bit dividend
architecture.output: BF16 significand/exponent multiply with round-to-nearest-even before gamma multiplication and after gamma multiplication

numeric.input_range: finite BF16 magnitudes below 32768 subject to a checked 64-bit sum-of-squares bound; larger or nonfinite inputs return error; values below the Q16.16 reduction and BF16 normal ranges may underflow
numeric.reference: x.float().pow(2).mean(-1) then rsqrt, BF16 cast of normalized x, BF16 gamma multiplication
numeric.observed_error: maximum 2 BF16 ULP on deterministic and exact-checkpoint first-layer prefill/decode vectors; numerical sweep of all 120 RMSNorm calls (1,140,480 elements) had no value above 2 ULP; RTL also passed the 20,352 maximum-input case

verification.proof_scope: standalone BF16 golden, 150 MHz OOC and DDR DMA_LOAD→RMSNORM→GEMM XSIM passed; board route and physical execution pending
